description: This file defines the ConnectionTag class, representing the ID and revision of a connection within the system. It includes methods to create instances from parameters or JSON objects, facilitating object construction and JSON deserialization.

classes.name: ConnectionTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a connection's ID and revision, with factory methods for creation and JSON deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionTag instance with the given connection ID and revision.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a ConnectionTag instance from a JSON object, extracting necessary fields and handling exceptions.
